summary: Piped natural gas pipeline installation for domestic cooking and water geysers.

steps.title: Check pipeline network availability
steps.description: Verify whether gas pipeline riser has been laid in your residential lane or apartment tower.

steps.title: Submit online connection request
steps.description: Submit ownership proof or NOC from landlord along with identity details.

steps.title: Pay refundable connection deposit
steps.description: Pay security deposit online or opt for installments integrated into bimonthly gas bills.

steps.title: Internal kitchen piping installation
steps.description: Utility technician installs yellow GI pipeline, copper tubing, gas isolation valve, and digital meter.

steps.title: Stove conversion and gas commissioning
steps.description: Technician adjusts stove nozzle from LPG to PNG and commissions gas flow safely.
